title: 第308章 谁给你的自信第307章 仇人复活
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：749局：我一个邪修考编怎么了第一卷：默认第308章谁给你的自信？（..la）阴行扎纸婆这话一出，办公室里的空气冷得让人发抖。
有人敢给这十万大山里的老怪物下局？
真是活腻歪了！
“这还得了？！”
墙角的大白一听，机会来了。
它绿豆小眼一转，从墙角跳了出来，昂首挺胸，用力拍着自己的胸脯，表起了忠心。
“嘎！三祖！这是哪个不长眼的王八蛋，敢在太岁头上动土！活得不耐烦了！”
大白满脸煞气，义愤填膺：“不用您老人家亲自动手！脏了您的手！只要您一句话，小鹅我愿为您赴汤蹈火，万死不辞！白爷……呸，小鹅我现在就提着枪杀过去，把那孙子大卸八块，抽筋扒皮，把他的魂魄硬生生扯出来，给您老人家做成擦鞋的纸垫子！”
然而，沙发上的阴行扎纸婆却连看都没看大白一眼。
她只是端着灵茶，唤了一声：“大白啊。”
“唰！”
上一秒还手舞足蹈的大白，一下僵在原地，浑身的汗毛全都竖了起来！
“在……小鹅在！”
大白打了个激灵，双腿一软，差点跪下，声音抖得不成样子。
阴行扎纸婆转过头，上下打量着大白，皱了下眉。
“小邪下山历练这大半年，修行一日千里，连万魂幡都练出了名堂，现在都已经是元婴境了。”
扎纸婆的语气不带起伏，“你这只死鹅，成天跟在小邪身边，享受着最好的资源，怎么到现在……还是个化神境巅峰，半点突破洞虚的迹象都没有？”
“嘎……”大白冷汗刷地一下就下来了，疯狂咽着口水，一个字都憋不出来。
扎纸婆将茶杯放在桌子上。
“老婆子给你一年的时间。”

她语气平淡，“一年之内，你要是突破不了洞虚境……”
扎纸婆苍白的嘴角咧开：“那你就滚回恶人谷，去药池里，舒舒服服地泡上几天吧。”
“卧槽！！！”
大白吓得眼珠子都快瞪出来了！
那哪是什么泡澡的地方！
那是恶人谷老二，那个蛊毒鬼医用来淬炼万毒的人间炼狱！
里面全是剧毒的蛊虫和腐蚀骨头的毒液！
大白哪怕是化神境的妖躯，进去泡几分钟，也得被折磨得掉三层皮！
“能！绝对能！”
大白吓得魂飞魄散，脑袋拼命地摇，“三祖您放心！小鹅我保证一年内突破到洞虚境！那什么药池……就、就免了吧，小鹅我皮糙肉厚，不配享受那等福地啊！”
看着大白快尿裤子的怂样，阴行扎纸婆冷哼了一声，不再理会这只造粪机器。
她站起身，转头看向陈邪。
脸上的阴森一扫而空，变得柔和起来。
她伸出手，替陈邪理了理有些发皱的衣领。
“行了，为师也就是路过西开市，顺道过来看看你。”
扎纸婆拍了拍陈邪的肩膀，“见你这小混账没少一根毫毛，甚至还胖了一圈，为师就放心了。”
陈邪嘿嘿一笑：“那是，徒儿在外头，绝不吃亏，谁敢惹我，我就灭谁魂。”
“乖。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Bureau 749: What happened to me, an evil cultivator? Volume 1: Default Chapter 308: Who gave you the confidence? (..la) As soon as Yin Xing Zha Zhi Po said these words, the air in the office was so cold that it made people shiver.
Does anyone dare to give this old monster in the Hundred Thousand Mountains a try?
It’s so boring!
"Is this okay?!"
When Dabai in the corner heard this, the opportunity came.
The mung bean rolled its little eyes, jumped out from the corner, held its head high, and patted its chest hard to show its loyalty.
"Gah! Third Ancestor! What kind of blind bastard dares to disturb Tai Sui! He is impatient to live!"
Dabai's face was filled with evil spirit and righteous indignation: "You don't have to do it yourself! I've dirty your hands! As long as you say a word, Xiaoge, I will go through fire and water for you, even if I die! Master Bai... Bah, Xiaoge, I will go over with a gun right now, cut the grandson into eight pieces, peel off the muscles and skin, tear out his soul, and make it into a paper mat for your shoes!"
However, the Yin Xing Zha Zhi Po on the sofa didn't even look at Da Bai.
She just held the spiritual tea and called out: "Dabai."
"Uh-huh!"
Dabai, who was dancing and dancing just a second ago, suddenly froze in place, and all the hairs on his body stood up!
"Here...the little goose is here!"
Dabai shuddered, his legs went weak, and he almost knelt down, his voice trembled.
Yin Xing Zha Zhi Po turned her head, looked Dabai up and down, and frowned.
"Xiao Xie has been practicing since he came down the mountain for more than half a year. His practice has been rapid. He has even mastered the Ten Thousand Soul Flags and is now at the Nascent Soul Realm."
Zha Zhi Po's tone was calm, "You are a dead goose. You have been following Xiao Xie all day long, enjoying the best resources. How come you are now... still at the peak of the Personalized God Realm, with no signs of breaking through the void?"
"Gah..." Dabai broke out in a cold sweat and swallowed crazily, unable to hold back a single word.
Zha Zhi Po placed the teacup on the table.
"The old lady gives you one year."
Her tone was calm, "If you can't break through the Dongxu Realm within a year..."
The corners of Zha Zhi Po's pale mouth widened: "Then you go back to the Valley of the Wicked, go to the medicine pool, and soak in comfort for a few days."
"Fuck!!!"
Dabai was so scared that his eyes almost popped out!
What kind of bathing place is that?
That's the hell on earth that the evil ghost doctor used to refine all kinds of poisons!
It's full of poisonous worms and bone-corroding venom!
Even if Dabai is a demon in the realm of gods, if he goes in and soaks for a few minutes, he will be tortured until three layers of his skin fall off!
"Yes! Absolutely!"
Dabai was so frightened that he shook his head desperately, "Third Ancestor, don't worry! Xiao Goose, I promise to break through to the Cave Void Realm within a year! What kind of medicine pool... just, just don't do it, Xiao Goose, I am thick-skinned and thick-skinned, and I don't deserve to enjoy such a blessed place!"
Seeing how cowardly Dabai was about to pee his pants, Yin Xing Zhi Po snorted coldly and ignored the feces-making machine.
She stood up and turned to look at Chen Xie.
The gloominess on his face disappeared and became softer.
She stretched out her hand and straightened Chen Xie's wrinkled collar.
"Okay, as a teacher, I just want to pass by Xikai City and come over to see you."
Zha Zhi Po patted Chen Xie on the shoulder and said, "Seeing that your little bastard has not lost a single hair and has even gained weight, I feel relieved as a teacher."
Chen Xie chuckled: "That's right, my disciple is outside and will never suffer any loss. I will destroy the soul of anyone who dares to mess with me."
"Be good."
